description: sflow_1d_si_nh_bar with the one-step predictor (A 210 11): one stage, the BCG advection with its source term (dt/2 of -g grad(eta^n) and of the non-hydrostatic pressure of the step before), the advecting discharge at t^{n+1/2}, the pressure terms at t^{n+1/2} (second order in time also for the nonlinear terms).
covers: A 210 11 time levels, pressure depth at t^{n+1/2}
